notes.title: Dojo System's latest banger takes you to the fair by the hand of Barraka!
notes.content:
[h1]Dojo System's latest firecracker takes you to the fair by the hand of Zomorro Studio🎪![/h1].

[previewyoutube=jcsuZnav9js;full][/previewyoutube]
Join Ainhoa on her exciting adventure through a mysterious village fair set in the 90's! This amazing journey will be packed with exploration, puzzles and surprises, from her mother's warm churro stand to an epic showdown with the wicked witch and her minions. As you collect coins and progress through this magical and fascinating amusement park, you will encounter new levels, challenges, huts and mini-games. Barraka's incredible world has been meticulously created by hand with plasticine and animated using the stop motion technique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063702/2a9267135d58adab71d30683b507ef2ae8806f75.png[/img]
Get ready to meet and help unforgettable characters while facing colorful enemies that will make you laugh your head off. Visit the haunted house, explore a mysterious mini-circus, ride the bumper cars, or enjoy a merry-go-round that transforms into a horizontal scrolling space shooter with a boss ending - every corner of Barraka Fair holds surprises that are as fun as they are challenging!

You can now add Barraka to your wishlist on Steam thanks to Dojo System.

[b]Characteristics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Beautifully crafted graphics that combines real images, stop motion and traditional animation to recreate an amazing plasticine universe.
[*] A magical world where lovable characters and disturbing enemies coexist.
[*] Enjoy unforgettable attractions: the bumper cars, the merry-go-round, the haunted house and much more.
[Test your wits, complete challenging levels and find all the coins.
[*] Have fun with classic mini-games that will test your skills such as mole smashing or target shooting.
[*] Buy new equipment and upgrade it to help Ainhoa progress in her adventure and discover all the secrets of the mysterious amusement park.
[*] Let yourself be caught by its ambient soundtrack and its hilarious sound effects.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041440/Barraka/
